verdict.rationale: Stripe documents fast paths to accepting card payments: no-code Payment Links that can be shared immediately, and a prebuilt Stripe-hosted or embedded Checkout page. A hands-on user reports being up and running and accepting payments in under an hour. However, the 'within a day of signing up' element depends on live-mode account activation, which the pack never documents, and one user reports being denied an account outright, so same-day live acceptance is not guaranteed for every founder. missing for 10: documented account activation/verification timeline from sign-up to live payments, first-party evidence of eligibility requirements that could delay go-live.

support.subject: As a founder, I can accept an online card payment within a day of signing up

citations.quote: Create a payment link and share it on social media, in emails, or on your website.
Customers enter their payment details in a fully-featured payment page, either embedded on your site or via a redirect to a Stripe-hosted page.
Create a payments page with prebuilt UIs using the Checkout Sessions API.
I was up and running and accepting recurring payments in less than an hour.
